clips.title: Genie Sessions: Can You Force a Genie to Do TDD?
clips.why: Kent Beck makes an AI agent work test first: a failing test before any code. It is the same order our bug fixers must follow, shown live and unpolished.
look: The test is written and seen failing before the implementation changes.
Watch how often the agent wants to jump ahead to code, and how the failing test pulls it back.
clips.after: Our harness makes that order a rule: the new test must fail on the base commit before the fix counts.

clips.title: Stop Letting Claude Code Grade Its Own Work
clips.why: In this experiment the agent's own checks miss problems that an outside check finds. That is why the proof is run by the harness, not by the agent that wrote the fix.
look: The blind spot: checks the agent writes for itself tend to share its mistakes.
The outside check sees what the agent did not.
clips.after: Running the new test against the old code, in a separate worktree, is our outside check: the agent cannot make the base commit agree with it.

practice.q: Name the git feature the harness uses to have the base commit and the fix side by side.
practice.hint: A second working folder for the same repo.
practice.why: A worktree is a second checkout at another commit, so the same test can run on the old code and on the fix.

practice.q: Put a bug fixer's work in order.
items: Triage: a duplicate? the right team? how bad?
Reproduce the bug as a failing test
Find the root cause and make the smallest fix
The harness runs the test on the base commit, where it must fail on an assertion
The harness runs the test on the fix, where it must pass, and the PR shows both logs
practice.why: Reproduce before fixing, and prove with two runs that the harness, not the agent, performs.

practice.q: The root cause of a bug is in a serializer that four API views share. What does the bug fixer do before changing it?

options.text: Changes it at once, because the fix is obvious
options.why: A change used in four places is not small and local, so a person should see the plan first.

options.text: Sends the plan, with the root cause at file and line, to the ticket's owner with Approve, Change and Stop, and waits
options.why: Bigger fixes wait for a person's yes. The run waits on a signal and holds no VM idle for long.

options.text: Copies the serializer so only one view changes
options.why: That fixes one caller and leaves a duplicate. The fixer fixes the reported bug at its cause.

practice.q: The flaky-test fixer adds time.sleep(1) and the test passes 50 times in a row. Is it done?

options.why: A sleep hides the flake instead of fixing its cause, so its charter forbids it.

options.text: No: adding sleeps or retries is forbidden for this routine, so the false-heal check rejects the run
options.why: The proof needs the cause fixed. A sleep only makes the race less likely to show.

options.text: Only if a person approves the sleep
options.why: The rule is in the charter and enforced by code, not left to a reviewer.
